items.title: Onsemi beats Q2 estimates, guides Q3 revenue above consensus
items.summary: Investing.com -- Onsemi (NASDAQ:ON) reported second quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations, with adjusted earnings per share of $0.74 beating the consensus estimate of $0.71 by $0.03. Revenue reached $1.6 billion, surpassing the analyst estimate of $1.59 billion and representing a 9% increase YoY from $1.47 billion in the second quarter of 2025.

items.title: GlobalFoundries Stock Costs More Than The Market On Earnings And Less On Cash Flow
